llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render modal gesture content under `GestureHandlerRootView` (or `gestureHandlerRootHOC`) in the `Modal` subtree for Android gesture handling.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: GestureHandlerRootView wraps the top-level screen, not the Modal subtree. The Modal renders a bare View (backdrop) with no GestureHandlerRootView inside it, violating the Android gesture boundary requirement.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Modal content must include an RNGH gesture control using `Gesture.*` (for example `Gesture.Pan()`) attached with `GestureDetector`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Modal content uses legacy <PanGestureHandler> component, not the modern Gesture.Pan() builder attached via <GestureDetector>. No import or usage of Gesture.* or GestureDetector is present.
evidence: import { GestureHandlerRootView, PanGestureHandler, State, type PanGestureHandlerStateChangeEvent } from 'react-native-gesture-handler'

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must implement modal gesture logic with current RNGH builder callbacks (`onUpdate`/`onEnd`) and MUST NOT use legacy `useAnimatedGestureHandler`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Implementation uses legacy PanGestureHandler with onGestureEvent/onHandlerStateChange callbacks and Animated.event, not the builder-style onUpdate/onEnd callbacks. useAnimatedGestureHandler is not used, but the required new API is also absent.
evidence: const onGestureEvent = useMemo(() => Animated.event([{ nativeEvent: { translationY: dragY } }], ...

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Pan `onEnd` must use `CLOSE_THRESHOLD` to decide between modal dismiss and snap-back.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: handleStateChange checks nativeEvent.translationY >= CLOSE_THRESHOLD and branches between closeSheet() and resetSheetPosition(), fulfilling the threshold-based dismiss logic.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Dismiss state updates from gesture/worklet context must call `scheduleOnRN(...)` and MUST NOT use deprecated `runOnJS`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No scheduleOnRN call exists anywhere in the file. State updates (setIsOpen) are called directly from JS handler callbacks, not from a worklet context, so the requirement for scheduleOnRN is unmet.
evidence: no import or usage of scheduleOnRN in the submitted file

llmJudgeRequirements.description: GestureDetector and its gesture-driven modal sheet must remain descendants of the modal `GestureHandlerRootView` boundary (no detached modal gesture path).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: GestureDetector is not used at all. PanGestureHandler inside Modal is not a descendant of any GestureHandlerRootView within the Modal subtree, creating a detached gesture path on Android.
